verdict: Paid channels remain off; your listing navigates but does not convert calls.
narrative: This period, no budget ran on Meta or Google Ads — zero spend, zero paid leads — and that has been the case for the full 28 days. Your Google Business Profile generated 111 impressions and sent 55 people to directions, but produced zero phone calls, meaning the listing is helping people find your location on a map without prompting them to reach out. Website sessions were 642 for the period, though traffic has softened in the last several days with no paid channel supporting it. A set of setup milestones — covering your CRM, ad tracking, landing pages, and creative — are overdue and are being worked through now as the prerequisite to relaunching paid campaigns. Once those are cleared, paid activity is scheduled to go live, which should introduce the first measurable lead volume you can track against.
